## Safety and content review

- [ ] No repair instruction is marked reviewed/published without a genuine qualified mechanic review.
- [ ] Component compatibility, warnings, stop conditions, and source references were checked where content changed.
- [ ] No secrets, real request records, or private personal data are included.
- [ ] No third-party media, text, CAD, or other assets were added without checking their licence and permitted use.
